A third test build of the new HOME Menu art, ahead of 0.2.1. The game itself is the same as 0.2.0.

rc.2's 3D banner froze the HOME Menu. Looking back over every banner made with this pipeline, two work on a console (3dsDL's and 3dsFM's) and seven have crashed or frozen. Each failed one did something the working two never do, but no single feature explains all of them. So the banner is now built only from patterns those two working banners use, and the build checks this. Run against the old models, the check passes both working banners and rejects every failed one, including rc.1 and rc.2.

What changed in the scene: the rust is shaped from geometry instead of a texture (only the wordmark keeps one, as in the working banners), the fog and the ash hang under one barely moving bone the way 3dsDL's sparkles hang under its card, and every moving part has all three animation tracks.

> **Still a console test.** If the HOME Menu crashes or freezes again, hold POWER to switch off, start the console, open FBI without highlighting sh23ds and reinstall 0.2.0's CIA over it. If the HOME Menu starts on sh23ds and fails again, start once without the SD card. `sh23ds-still-banner.cia` has the same scene without animation: if the main CIA freezes, try that one next, since it tells an animation fault apart from a model fault in one test.

- **Icon:** the website's mark, nine rusted red squares on black, in both the CIA and the 3DSX.
- **Name and details:** "Silent Hill 2", "The PC Director's Cut, ported to the 3DS", by "sh23ds by ankushKun".
- **3D banner:** the mark swaying in fog with ash falling and the SILENT HILL 2 wordmark in front, with a short jingle of radio static, two heartbeats and a low chord.
